newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK blue chips slip in morning, hurt by rate fears.
newsitem.headline: HK blue chips slip in morning, hurt by rate fears.

text.p: Hong Kong blue chips slipped in morning trade on Tuesday as prices came under pressure from concerns about the interest rate picture, brokers said.
The Hang Seng index was down 54.99 points, or 0.43 percent, at 12,783.54 after rising 102.0 points on Monday. Turnover was HK$1.60 billion after the first 45 minutes of trade.
"There is not enough momentum to push the index to a higher level due to worries about an imminent interest rate hike," said Patrick Chia, research director at China Everbright Research.
The U.S. Federal Reserve will meet on March 25 to deliberate interest rates.
"Short term the market is going to be very volatile," said Miles Remington, sales trader at Soc-Gen Crosby Securities.
"You have got to have the bravery to get out there and get involved."
He said signals from U.S. markets were mixed. The Dow industrials rose 20.02 points to 6,955.48 on Monday after falling as much as 80 points during the session.
But the U.S. long bond fell 5/32 to yield 6.96 percent.
"Although the Dow Jones managed to rebound, the bond yield is still at a very high level," added Chia.
Brokers put support for the Hang Seng at 12,600 points. "But that all depends on whether there is a major correction in the property market," said Chia.
Analysts said the response to property sales by Hong Kong's major developers was encouraging but investors still feared that the government would impose measures to curb speculation.
Shares in Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd fell HK$0.50 to HK$70.00 and Hang Lung Development Co Ltd slipped HK$0.40 to HK$14.55.
But Henderson Land Development Co Ltd, which is expected by analysts to report strong interim profit growth on Wednesday, rose HK$0.25 to HK$64.75.
Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd is due to release its interim results on Thursday. Its shares rose HK$0.50 to HK$84.75.
Shares in Hongkong Telecom were steady at HK$14.40 after rising HK$0.40 on Monday continued speculation that a Chinese partner would buy a stake in the company.
March Hang Seng Index futures fell 92 points to 12,748.
